verdict.rationale: Superset is an agent-orchestration product, so a training opt-out is a fair privacy question for it. The pack has no evidence of any setting or policy that keeps user data out of AI model training. The local-first claim that code never leaves the machine is an adjacent data-locality feature, not a training-use control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
